status: research only; URI not registered; no native or MCP implementation

transport.request_json: String containing one strict JSON object, not an object argument and not a second JSON-encoded string
transport.outer_boundary: Existing MCP backend ignores extra outer keys; current Agent requires exact outer fields. Do not claim backend behavior changed.

semantic_constraints.metrics: 1..32 declared regular names, case-insensitive identity, no case duplicates; unknown/window names rejected; request-name UTF8 bytes<=128
semantic_constraints.predicate: One unaliased SQL comparison: a single unqualified, unquoted declared regular metric on the left, exact nonNULL numeric constant on the right; comparison kinds equality, inequality, >, >=, <, <= (examples use = and <>; no exhaustive lexical spelling claim). Native Expression rejects double quotes, NUL, aliases and multiple expressions; binding checks numeric type/scale/range. Count requires an integral constant representable as BIGINT. Currency accepts integral or DECIMAL, decimal scale<=2 and exact DECIMAL(38,2) representation; DOUBLE rejected. No metric-to-metric, field/window reference, arithmetic/composite Boolean predicate, function/cast expression or NULL constant. Metric may be absent from selected output metrics. Unary sign/exponent spellings are not promised without parser verification.
semantic_constraints.sets: Each atomic predicate becomes a TRUE member set within common row-presence domain. NULL/UNKNOWN/FALSE are not atomic members. Intersection/union combine sets; difference is left minus right TRUE members, order-sensitive; all denotes the complete common domain. No nullable NOT substitution.
semantic_constraints.strict_json: Unknown and duplicate inner object fields rejected, required fields explicit, operation case-sensitive, request strings cannot contain NUL
semantic_constraints.schema_limits: Structural JSON Schema alone does not enforce duplicate raw JSON keys, UTF8 byte budgets, node/depth totals, case-fold name uniqueness, declared metric membership, predicate parsing or numeric binding.
semantic_constraints.nested_vs_recursive: Bounded nested binary JSON trees are supported. Named/self-referential recursion is not expressible by this contract. Clarify the current discovery refusal wording recursive cohorts rather than falsely forbidding nesting.

snapshot_binding: Contract version/hash identifies static grammar; actual program six bindings identify frozen runtime/data; they are distinct. Discovery client should validate applicability and freeze both in context/replay, not silently infer compatibility.
version_scope: No project API version or MCP protocol upgrade proposed here.
